dispositions.topic_text: State 6 representation and contract shape of OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES
dispositions.reason: Already decided in State 6: the data closure (70_data_provider_closure.json) holds OWNER_SESSION_COOKIE_ATTRIBUTES as a string constant, 'Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/', written into the Set-Cookie field as it stands.

dispositions.topic_text: Meaning and enforceability of restricting the owner-session cookie to Registry's origin when ports differ
dispositions.reason: No witness: the browser is used only for the owner interface, and the service API authenticates by its bearer token alone and reads no cookie, so an owner cookie a browser might send to the other port grants nothing there (as State 3 round-74 T6).
